anchors.paper_title: MI-B dataset of the BCI competition WRCC2023
anchors.reason: The candidate is the Harvard Dataverse record (DOI 10.7910/DVN/HFNWRX) of the MI-B dataset, which is the source deposit listed in the README. Its title, three-class MI task and stroke/healthy subjects match nm000298.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this motor imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the WRCC2023 MI-B recordings.

metadata.methods_description: Cued offline three-class motor imagery paradigm (left hand, right hand, both feet) with 90 interleaved 4-second trials per subject, 30 per class. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle 64-channel system, 59 EEG channels retained, at 1000 Hz with a 50 Hz line frequency.
